title: The Bhootnii
desc: After a heartbreak, Shantanu unknowingly summons a spirit named Mohabbat, whose obsessive presence begins to disrupt the peace of the entire college campus.

title: K3 - Kaali Ka Karishma
desc: A young man, who lives happily with his family but is scared of ghosts, visits Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with his family. There, he is soon possessed by a vengeful ghost with a sinister past.

title: Aranmanai 4
desc: Suspicious about his sister's death, Saravanan, a lawyer, tries to solve the mystery behind it, only to discover a mysteriously dark force at play.

title: Phone Bhoot
desc: Inspired by stories from their childhood, two young men create a business around capturing ghosts. However, their endeavour turns dangerous when they must fulfil their promise to a poltergeist.

title: Sabdham
desc: A paranormal investigator tackles mysterious university deaths. As evidence mounts, they question their beliefs and confront a possible supernatural threat.

title: Tumbbad
desc: Vinayak Rao, a resident of the village Tumbbad, repeatedly steals the ill-fated wealth of the evil Hastar, until his greed and heinous acts become the reason for his doom.

title: Naya Khoon
desc: Siblings Vikram and Seema have contrasting personalities. However, things take a turn when Seema decides to marry Anand, but her brother opposes her decision.

title: Rangrezz
desc: Rishi, Vinu and Pakyya are three friends who want to excel in their respective careers. However, when their other friend, Joy, faces trouble with his lover, they decide to help him elope with her.

title: Raazi
desc: As diplomatic tensions rise in 1971, a daring Kashmiri woman walks the tightrope between marriage and duty, delving into the shadows of espionage to protect her motherland.

title: Policegiri
desc: Tired of the rampant corruption fueled by Nagori Subramaniam, DCP Rudra takes a defiant stand. He launches a one-man crusade to take down the crime lord and dismantle his criminal syndicate.

title: Baby John
desc: An indomitable policeman goes to greater lengths and leads a double life in order to protect his daughter from the criminal underworld.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya, a married couple, hire Madhubala, a prostitute, as the surrogate mother of their child. Trouble brews when Madhubala falls in love with Raj and insists on keeping the child.

title: Skanda
desc: A skilled martial artist's life changes when a secret agency recruits him to stop terrorists. He faces a dangerous mission that will test his abilities and courage beyond anything he is known.

title: Bhoot Bangla
desc: After inheriting a cursed ancestral palace in Mangalpur, Arjun hosts his sister Meera's wedding there. The decision unleashes a violent supernatural force tied to their family history.

title: Aravind Sametha Veera Raghava
desc: A young man sets out to avenge his father's death but soon realises that violence is not the key to his salvation. His life changes when he meets another man, who helps him rediscover himself.
